scripts.dev:web: npm run build -w packages/engine && npm run dev -w packages/web
scripts.dev:server: npm run build -w packages/engine && npm run dev -w packages/server
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/engine && npm run build -w packages/server && npm run build -w packages/web
scripts.test:engine: npm run test -w packages/engine && npm run selftest -w packages/engine
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/engine && tsc --noEmit -p packages/server/tsconfig.json && tsc -b packages/web
scripts.ci: npm run build -w packages/engine && npm run typecheck && npm run lint -w packages/web && npm run test:engine
